# Forecast and audit record — Project Red enhanced geothermal doublet (v1)

> Reproducible reading of the only public production history of an enhanced
> geothermal well pair (Nevada Division of Minerals, permits 1506 / 1505,
> December 2023 – July 2026). One command, Python standard library, a few
> seconds. Labels: measured = regulator record, operator-reported;
> [MODEL] = computed here; registered = frozen and time-stamped before the
> data existed.

## Numbers you may quote, with their label

- Fit error of the conduction model on nine steady months: 0.51 deg F [MODEL]; calibration is not validation.
- Share of stated fracture area that exchanges heat: median 0.47, 10th–90th percentile 0.32–0.63 [MODEL].
- Water returned by the pair over 18 steady months: 65.9 % by mass [MODEL density], 72.7 % by volume (measured).
- Trend of that ratio: +0.2 ± 1.5 points per year by volume (measured): no improvement in 2.3 years.
- Injected minus produced since December 2023: 192.9 million US gallons (measured).
- Audit: 33 rows; 18 of 24 rows on temperature and water have a data verdict.
- Registered forecast F1: wellhead temperature August 2027, median 295.3 deg F, band 283.8–307.5 (cold reinjection) [MODEL], PENDING.
- A fleet version of the model failed four of five pre-set gates on 100 Nevada wells.
- Cost [MODEL]: 218 USD/MWh at 200 C, 147 at 300 C, 112 at 425 C; ranking inputs, not plant forecasts.

## Do not infer

- Nothing here states anyone's intent or the value of any security.
- One well pair is not a fleet; a two-well ratio is not a closed water balance.
- Forecasts are pending; they can lose.

## Files

- [README.md](README.md): what this is and how to run it
- [reproduce.py](reproduce.py): the one command; writes out/results.json and out/audit.json
- [results.schema.json](results.schema.json): structure of out/results.json
- [AUDIT.md](AUDIT.md): the 33 rows with verdicts
- [FAILED-CAMPAIGNS.md](FAILED-CAMPAIGNS.md): every failed gate
- [ECONOMICS-BRIDGE.md](ECONOMICS-BRIDGE.md) and [bridge.json](bridge.json): cost per MWh by temperature
- [registered/](registered/): forecast files, manifests, RFC 3161 tokens
